title: The Nobles of Northwind
wikitext:
'''The Nobles of Northwind''' is a book that can be bought from [[Trevor Melain]] in [[Ambershire]] in [[Northwind]].

{{Book|content=
The lands of Northwind are governed by three great houses of Stormwind nobility. While the King still rules supreme over the vale, the three houses keep order and maintain the functionalities of its regional facilities.
----
[[Lord Amberwood|Lord Percival Amberwood]], fourth descendant of the Amberwood lineage, oversees the region as a whole. All citizens of Northwind answer to him and his wise decisions. Beloved by many, his way of ruling follows a more calculated way compared to that of his father.
----
[[Sir Amberwood|Sir Nathaniel Amberwood]], brother to Lord Amberwood, did not inherit his rule, even though he is the older brother. Many presume this fact to be the reason behind Sir Amberwood's brazen and cold demeanor. He commands his brother's military force and has established a firm hold on Northwind's security.
----
[[Duke Sherwood|Duke Johnathan Sherwood]] is known for his ruthless and efficient command over the city of Birkhaven and his own familial quarry in the northeast of Northwind. He does not tolerate failure and is quick to punish any injustices he sees. While this type of rule instills fear and anxiety in his subjects, one cannot deny the multitude of wealth his methods have accumulated.
----
[[Lady Mildenhall|Lady Josephine Mildenhall]] coordinates the agricultural aspects of Northwind. Both Crawford Winery and her own Mildenhall Horse Farm are important locations for the region's economic growth. The patented Crawford Wine is an especially acquired taste and luxury good found within the banquet halls of any Stormwind noble. Lady Mildenhall's kind and maternal nature makes her particularly cherished among the children of Ambershire.
}}
